column3: “For the sons of Naphtali” is repeated in Hebrew; BSB names the tribe once.
The east is expressed as the “rising of the sun”; BSB says “on the east”.
“Later” is supplied in BSB. The Hebrew twice names “sons of Dan”, repeats Leshem, and describes the sword as having a “mouth”; BSB condenses these expressions.
The Hebrew says “according to the mouth of the LORD” and “built the city”; BSB has “as the LORD had commanded” and “rebuilt the city”.
The Hebrew names the “heads of the fathers” and the “sons of Israel”; BSB has “heads of the families” and “tribes of Israel”.
